scope: isolated QROS/RISE research and engineering branches
objective: Prevent starvation caused by repeatedly chasing unrelated main-branch advances while preserving fail-closed reconciliation for overlapping changes.

rules.lease_acquisition: A lane acquires a lease only after verifying the exact base_head_sha and creating the isolated branch from that SHA.
rules.lease_authority: During the lease, base_head_sha remains authoritative for that lane.
reconcile_during_execution_if: durable authority explicitly supersedes or invalidates a pinned dependency
security/integrity incident affects a pinned dependency
rules.orthogonal_terminal_delta: reconcile once, reuse content-addressed neutral blobs, regenerate base-dependent receipts, rerun affected tests
rules.overlapping_terminal_delta: explicit conflict reconciliation and full affected-gate rerun
rules.old_pass_reuse: FORBIDDEN across authority leases unless receipt is explicitly base-neutral and its referenced content identities are unchanged
rules.neutral_blob_reuse: ALLOWED only by immutable content SHA
rules.blocked_lane: freeze durable blocker and continue orthogonal valid lanes
rules.no_progress: expired progress lease must recover, resume, relaunch, or block; repeated identical search is not progress

merge_guard: No merge to main without a terminal reconciliation receipt against current live main.
